description: Cross-cutting envelope that propagates with every artifact through the 7 ACVP components (Reality, Contracts, Schemas, State machines, Events, Hashes, Tests). Refines the pattern's narrative 4-state framing (bronze/silver/gold/refuted) into 2 orthogonal axes: tier (3-state promotion ladder per medallion architecture) + grounding_status (3-state epistemic tristate per loa-hounfour epistemic-tristate doctrine). Source-of-truth doctrine: patterns/grounding-ladder-as-substrate-primitive.md.

envelope_id.description: Unique identifier for this envelope · ties artifact to provenance chain · stable across asserted_at updates

artifact_path.description: Path to the artifact this envelope grounds (file path · URI · or content-addressable identifier)

tier.description: Promotion ladder position (medallion architecture applied to agentic content). bronze=agent-forward (default for new artifacts); silver=operator-blessed via activation receipt; gold=UTC-backed with directionally-correct or strongly-validated learning. Monotonic for promotion (bronze→silver→gold); demotion may skip (gold→bronze valid when UTC moves and operator hasn't re-blessed). Refutation does NOT collapse tier — see grounding_status for the orthogonal epistemic axis.

grounding_status.description: Tristate epistemic status per loa-hounfour epistemic-tristate doctrine. Three states must require DIFFERENT consumer behaviors — collapse to two states = degenerated tristate. grounded=evidence (UTC link, operator signature) is current and valid · refuted=underlying UTC moved to hypothesis-failed OR operator marked refuted (refuted_at REQUIRED) · unverifiable=evidence cannot be confirmed right now (UTC unreachable, signature expired, network failure).

linked_utcs.description: User-truth canvas references. Anti-spiral tether (Eileen's UTC doctrine: binds artifact outputs to user truth so AI work doesn't drift). REQUIRED for tier=gold. Each link carries SHA-256 quote_hash for evidence integrity.

canvas_url.description: URL or path to the user-truth canvas (hivemind-laboratory canonical · or operator-equivalent)

quote_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized quote text from the UTC · evidence-integrity guarantee (mirrors loa-hounfour req-hash discipline)

learning_status.description: UTC's learning state per hivemind-laboratory labels.schema.json. tier=gold REQUIRES at least one linked UTC with learning_status in [strongly-validated, directionally-correct].

blessed_by.description: Who promoted this artifact past bronze. operator=operator-signed activation receipt · auto-derived=substrate inferred (via UTC link addition) · construct-consensus=multiple constructs voted to promote (requires metadata.consensus_voices)

operator_signed.description: Whether the signing operator has issued an activation receipt for this artifact. REQUIRED=true for tier=silver (unless blessed_by=construct-consensus with quorum). Signature is non-transferable: only the signing operator can revoke (multi-operator projects require operator-identity per OPERATORS.md).

asserted_at.description: When this envelope was last asserted (created or updated). Updates on tier promotion · demotion · linked_utcs change · grounding_status change.

refuted_at.description: When refutation occurred. REQUIRED when grounding_status=refuted. Preserved if grounding_status later changes (provenance trace).

refutation_reason.description: Free-text operator-helpful explanation of why refuted. Optional but encouraged for provenance + negative-ledger surface.

contract_version.description: Semver of the schema this envelope conforms to (this schema is 1.0.0). Enum-locked per loa-constructs governance · additive-only minor bumps · major requires migration + new file + stable $id.

metadata.description: Open metadata escape hatch · 10KB consumer-side cap by convention. Use for extensions that may graduate to first-class fields later. Known patterns: consensus_voices (for blessed_by=construct-consensus), last_known_tier_before_refute, activation_context, agent_source, promotion_context.
